# The total can go below zero

A discount larger than the price makes the total negative.

## Why it matters

A negative total means paying the customer.

## What fixed looks like

A total never goes below zero.

# A missing or broken settings file gives an unhelpful error

A missing or broken settings file stops the program with a technical error.

## Why it matters

Whoever runs it cannot tell which file to fix.

## What fixed looks like

A missing or broken settings file gives a message naming the file.
